title: Whole-system transpose normalization of the prescribed compact-support scalar comparison
statement:
Fix a field $K_0$, a prime $\ell$ invertible in $K_0$, finite extensions $A\subseteq B$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ in a fixed algebraic closure, and a separated finite-type $K_0$-morphism $f:X\to Y$ between finite-type schemes, with a fixed compactification $c=(j,p)$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. For $D=A,B$ and $W=X,\overline X,Y$, put $R_{D,n,W}=(\mathcal O_D/\varpi_D^{n+1})_W$, with actual quotient transitions. Use the ordinary unbounded derived categories $\mathscr D_D^W$ of strict semilinear module systems on the small pro-etale sites [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections, lem-pur-system-ringed-sequence-site]. Write $\mathcal R_D^W\dashv\mathcal L_D^W$ for coherent derived reduction and derived limit of restricted systems, with counit $\epsilon_D$ [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Write $S^W_{B/A}=-\otimes^L_{R_{A,\bullet,W}}R_{B,\bullet,W}$, $U^W_{B/A}$ for exact restriction, and $\zeta^W$ for the unit of $S^W_{B/A}\dashv U^W_{B/A}$ on this ringed sequence site [lem-pur-sheaf-ring-derived-coefficient-adjunction]. Let $H_D=Rp_{*,D}j_{!,D}:\mathscr D_D^X\to\mathscr D_D^Y$. Let $d:H_AU^X_{B/A}\xrightarrow{\sim}U^Y_{B/A}H_B$ be the canonical proper/open restriction comparison, with section-normalized open part and K-injective-normalized proper part [lem-weil-system-compact-support-restriction-cocycle].

Use the fixed integral compact-support functors $F_D$, completed scalar functors $C^W_{B/A}$, and the prescribed strict-tower comparison $b_{B/A}:C^Y_{B/A}F_A\xrightarrow{\sim}F_BC^X_{B/A}$ of [def-weil-compact-support-finite-action, def-weil-integral-scalar-extension, lem-weil-compact-support-normalized-scalar-isomorphisms], with the fixed system realization of [def-weil-system-operation-exchange-realization]. Thus $b$ denotes that prescribed construction, not an arbitrary map having its finite evaluations. Let
$$r_D:\mathcal R_D^Y F_D\xrightarrow{\sim}H_D\mathcal R_D^X,\qquad s_W:\mathcal R_B^W C^W_{B/A}\xrightarrow{\sim}S^W_{B/A}\mathcal R_A^W$$
be the whole-system operation counit and the coherent scalar reduction comparison [lem-pur-coefficient-extension-reduction-model].

The coherent mixed completed unit of [def-weil-mixed-reduction-unit], regarded as a map $\eta^W_H:\mathcal R_A^W H\to U^W_{B/A}\mathcal R_B^W C^W_{B/A}H$ of entire derived systems, satisfies
$$U^W_{B/A}(s_{W,H})\eta^W_H=\zeta^W_{\mathcal R_A^WH}.$$
For $L\in\mathscr D_A^X$, let $q_L:S^Y_{B/A}H_AL\to H_BS^X_{B/A}L$ be the scalar-adjunction transpose specified by
$$U^Y_{B/A}(q_L)\zeta^Y_{H_AL}=d_{S^X_{B/A}L}\,H_A(\zeta^X_L).$$
This equation characterizes $q_L$ in $\mathscr D_B^Y$, through the whole-system Hom bijection, for every derived target. On every integral constructible input $K$, the operation counits $r_D$ are coherent isomorphisms and
$$H_B(s_{X,K})\,r_{B,C^X_{B/A}K}\,\mathcal R_B^Y(b_{B/A,K})
=q_{\mathcal R_A^XK}\,S^Y_{B/A}(r_{A,K})\,s_{Y,F_AK}$$
in the derived category of entire $B$-coefficient systems. Moreover, under the fixed source and target realization isomorphisms obtained from these same $r_D,s_W,\epsilon_D$ and the prescribed Roos comparisons, $b_{B/A,K}$ itself is $\mathcal L_B^Y(q_{\mathcal R_A^XK})$. These assertions include the whole homotopy-category counit squares and both Roos coordinates. They impose no finite Tor-amplitude, quotient-flatness or finite-field hypothesis on $K_0$, and assert no faithfulness of separate evaluations. No composition or unit equation for a family of $b$'s is asserted.

proof.text: Auxiliary scalar coordinates: obtain exactness of scalar restriction from lem-pur-sheaf-ring-coefficient-ordinary-adjunction. Apply lem-cbc-cochain-derived-adjunction to the fixed sequence scalar model, its universal cochain counit and its K-flat computations. Two normalized units agree on a K-flat resolution after cancellation of the invertible comparison; naturality along its localized quasi-isomorphism then gives equality on every complex. Localization extensionality and Adjunction.ext give uniqueness.

Auxiliary ordinary geometric square: use the identity-on-sections sequenceScalarPullbackRight comparison already constructed in def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems. Its hom has the prescribed section formula by definition. Any two such natural isomorphisms have equal components on every section, hence equal homs, hence are equal.

All system operations below are operations on the ringed sequence site, not functors on a sequence of separate derived categories [lem-pur-system-ringed-sequence-site, lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. The prescribed realization [def-weil-system-operation-exchange-realization] identifies $F_D$ with $\mathcal L_D^YH_D\mathcal R_D^X$, using its projection-preserving identification with the fixed functor [def-weil-compact-support-finite-action]. Accordingly $r_{D,K}$ is $\epsilon_{D,H_D\mathcal R_D^XK}$ after that identification. Its evaluations are precisely the reduction adjuncts specified in that definition, which are isomorphisms. Joint conservativity of derived system evaluation makes $r_{D,K}$ a system isomorphism. The scalar model [lem-pur-coefficient-extension-reduction-model] gives $C^W H=\mathcal L_B^WS^W\mathcal R_A^WH$ with $s_{W,H}$ the counit followed by tensor association. Scalar extension preserves the integral constructible category [lem-weil-integral-scalar-extension-constructible], and compact support has constructible-complete values [lem-sf-integral-compact-support-constructible]. Thus the operation identifications apply also at $C^XK$ and $F_AK$.

proof.text: Fix $W,H$, and put $Q=H\otimes^L_{\widehat{\mathcal O}_{A,W}}\widehat{\mathcal O}_{B,W}$ and $T=S^W\mathcal R_A^WH$. Choose one flat-term K-flat representative $P$ of $H$ [lem-pc-kflat-resolution]. Change of rings preserves this resolving class [lem-pur-kflat-change-of-rings]. Tensor association gives an isomorphism $a:\mathcal R_B^WQ\to T$ whose formula is $(x\otimes b)\otimes\bar c\mapsto(x\otimes1)\otimes\bar b\bar c$. These are maps of the strict quotient diagrams. The quotient augmentation $P\otimes\widehat{\mathcal O}_{B,W}\to( P\otimes R_{B,n,W})_n$ realizes to the prescribed completion map $\chi:Q\to\mathcal L_B^WT$ [lem-pur-quotient-scalar-comparison-descent]; its hypothesis that countable products of $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{B,W}$-module sheaves are exact holds by [lem-weil-proetale-countable-products-exact]. By [lem-weil-strict-roos-comparison] the zero-shifted-product augmentation is the actual augmented total-limit map. Hence, under the reduction/limit Hom bijection [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], $\chi$ is the adjunct of $a$: ordinary tensor/limit transposition sends the compatible family $x\otimes b\mapsto x\otimes\bar b$ to that association map. Equivalently the triangle identity is the whole-system equality $\epsilon_{B,T}\mathcal R_B^W(\chi)=a$. The scalar comparison is $s_{W,H}=\epsilon_{B,T}$ followed by the same association identifications [lem-pur-coefficient-extension-reduction-model].

proof.text:
Let $
u:\mathcal R_A^WH	o U^W\mathcal R_B^WQ$ be reduction of the ordinary tensor unit. On the representatives of Step 2 it sends $x\otimes r$ to $(x\otimes1)\otimes\iota_n(r)$. The mixed unit specified in [def-weil-mixed-reduction-unit] is $\eta_H^W=U^W\mathcal R_B^W(\chi)
u$: the ordinary tensor unit is derived through its universal counit square, followed by exactly that diagonal completion map. The representative normalization of [lem-pur-sheaf-ring-derived-coefficient-adjunction] applies on the ringed sequence site, so this identifies the full homotopy-category square. Step 2 now gives $U^W(s_{W,H})\eta_H^W=U^W(a)
u$. Its strict tensor formula is $x\otimes r\mapsto(x\otimes r)\otimes1$, the unit $\zeta^W_{\mathcal R_A^WH}$ of the same derived scalar adjunction. This calculation takes place on simultaneous quotient representatives, before localization; its passage to derived systems is the representative-normalized adjunction, not a deduction from equality of evaluated morphisms.

proof.text: Apply [lem-pur-sheaf-ring-derived-coefficient-adjunction] to the ring map $R_{A,\bullet,Y}\to R_{B,\bullet,Y}$ on the sequence site [lem-pur-system-ringed-sequence-site]. For every $L$ and every target $Z$ it gives the bijection $\operatorname{Hom}(S^YH_AL,Z)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(H_AL,U^YZ)$, taking $v$ to $U^Y(v)\zeta^Y_{H_AL}$. The actual system isomorphism $d$ is supplied by [lem-weil-system-compact-support-restriction-cocycle]. Take $Z=H_BS^XL$ and transpose $d_{S^XL}H_A(\zeta_L^X)$. This constructs $q_L$ uniquely with precisely the equation in the statement, for arbitrary $L$. Naturality follows from naturality of $d,\zeta$ and of this Hom bijection. There is no constructibility or boundedness restriction on this construction or on $Z$.

proof.text:
Identify this transpose with the prescribed proper/open coefficient word. Write $P_D=Rp_{*,D}$, $J_D=j_{!,D}$, and let $v:S^{\overline X}J_A\to J_BS^X$ be the inverse open-adjunction mate and $w:S^YP_A\to P_BS^{\overline X}$ the proper coefficient mate. These are whole-system maps [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections, def-weil-system-operation-exchange-realization]. We claim
$$U(v_L)\zeta_{J_AL}=d^j_{S^XL}J_A(\zeta_L),\qquad U(w_M)\zeta_{P_AM}=d^p_{S^{\overline X}M}P_A(\zeta_M),$$
where $d^j,d^p$ are the open and proper factors of $d$; the proper factor is the K-injective-normalized comparison in [lem-weil-system-compact-support-restriction-cocycle], and the adjunctions and their coefficient mates are the normalized derived ones of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. Open equation: both sides are maps out of $J_AL$, and a map $J_AL\to Z$ is determined by its restriction $j^*$ precomposed with the invertible open unit [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization]. After restriction to the open, $v$ becomes the identity by that node, $d^j$ is the section-preserving identity, and the scalar unit restricts to the scalar unit (on flat-term representatives both are $x\mapsto x\otimes1$ [lem-pur-sheaf-ring-derived-coefficient-adjunction]); so both sides restrict to $\zeta_L$. Proper equation: $w$ is the mate [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate], for $p_A^{-1}\dashv P_A$ and $p_B^{-1}\dashv P_B$, of the inverse pullback/scalar identification $\sigma^{-1}:p_B^{-1}S^Y\cong S^{\overline X}p_A^{-1}$. By the iterated-mate identity [lem-trf-iterated-square-mates], the mate of $w$ under the scalar adjunctions is the conjugate of $\sigma^{-1}$ for the composite adjunctions $S^{\overline X}p_A^{-1}\dashv P_AU$ and $p_B^{-1}S^Y\dashv UP_B$. That conjugate is $d^p$: on a K-injective $B$-system $J$ with resolution $u:UJ\to I$, the conjugate word consists of the unit $x\mapsto x\otimes1$ on representatives, $\sigma$ (the identity on flat-term representatives) and the counit of $p^{-1}\dashv p_*$, and by the triangle identity it reduces to the inverse of $p_*u$, which is the normalization of [lem-weil-system-compact-support-restriction-cocycle]. By the mate bijection [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate], saying that the scalar mate of $w$ is $d^p$ is exactly the displayed proper equation.  For $k_L=P_B(v_L)w_{J_AL}$, naturality of $d^p$ gives
$$U(k_L)\zeta_{H_AL}=d^p_{J_BS^XL}P_A(U(v_L))P_A(\zeta_{J_AL})=d^p_{J_BS^XL}P_A(d^j_{S^XL})H_A(\zeta_L)=d_{S^XL}H_A(\zeta_L).$$
Thus $k_L=q_L$ by Step 4. Only mate formulas, naturality and composition were used; no equality was inferred after separate evaluations.

proof.text:
For constructible $K$, put $L=\mathcal R_A^XK$, $N=S^YH_AL$ and $N'=H_BS^XL$. Let
$$\xi_s:C^YF_AK\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal L_B^YN,\qquad\xi_t:F_BC^XK\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal L_B^YN'$$
be the fixed identifications: the source uses the scalar realization followed by $\mathcal L_B^YS^Y(r_{A,K})$; the target uses the operation realization followed by $\mathcal L_B^YH_B(s_{X,K})$. By [def-weil-system-operation-exchange-realization] finite-extension comparison is realization of exactly the proper coefficient mate followed by proper image of the inverse open mate. The prescribed $b$ of [lem-weil-compact-support-normalized-scalar-isomorphisms] is this strict-tower construction with its normalized limit, rather than an arbitrary integral map selected from its reductions. Consequently Step 5 gives, with these fixed identifications,
$$\xi_t\, b_{B/A,K}=\mathcal L_B^Y(q_L)\,\xi_s.$$
This proves the integral realization assertion directly from its prescribed construction. It has not used the uniqueness of a map with prescribed finite evaluations.

proof.text:
Write $h=S^Y(r_{A,K})s_{Y,F_AK}$ and $t=H_B(s_{X,K})r_{B,C^XK}$. Substituting the definitions of $\xi_s,\xi_t$ from Step 6 into counit naturality gives
$$\epsilon_{B,N}\mathcal R_B^Y(\xi_s)=h,\qquad \epsilon_{B,N'}\mathcal R_B^Y(\xi_t)=t.$$
Indeed the scalar comparison is the scalar realization counit, the operation comparison is the operation realization counit [def-weil-system-operation-exchange-realization, lem-pur-coefficient-extension-reduction-model], and moving $S^Y(r_A)$ or $H_B(s_X)$ through a counit is its ordinary naturality square [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Applying $\mathcal R_B^Y$ to Step 6 and composing with $\epsilon_{B,N'}$, the same naturality square for $q_L:N\to N'$ yields
$$t\,\mathcal R_B^Y(b)=\epsilon_{B,N'}\mathcal R_B^Y\mathcal L_B^Y(q_L)\mathcal R_B^Y(\xi_s)=q_L\epsilon_{B,N}\mathcal R_B^Y(\xi_s)=q_Lh.$$
Expanding $t,h$ is exactly the required equation. These are counit squares on entire homotopy/derived systems. All four changes of coordinates are the ones fixed in Steps 1 and 6.

proof.text: The cone coordinates are retained by these identifications. Countable products of completed-coefficient sheaves on each small pro-etale site are exact [lem-weil-proetale-countable-products-exact], so [lem-weil-strict-roos-comparison] identifies the strict Roos functor with total limit. On a representative strict map $a:T\to T'$, the realized map is $(y,x)\mapsto((\prod a_n)y,(\prod a_n)x)$ with differential $D(y,x)=(-dy-(1-s)x,dx)$ [lem-pur-strict-roos-homotopy-functor]. The quotient augmentation in Step 2 is $(0,(x\otimes\bar b)_n)$; scalar restriction preserves both products and the augmentation [lem-sfb-augmented-scalar-roos-resolution]. A simultaneous strict homotopy $h$ induces $(y,x)\mapsto(-h^\Pi y,h^\Pi x)$, so the same normalization passes through resolution comparisons and roofs. Thus Steps 2, 6 and 7 refer to the full normalized cone maps, including the shifted product. The construction works for the zero object, the empty source, and $A=B$ (multiplication becomes the tensor unitor). Ramification only changes the ring maps $R_{A,n}\to R_{B,n}$; derived tensors, not quotient-flatness, were used throughout. No finite Tor bound, finite ground field, or faithfulness of evaluations was invoked.
